description: This file defines an interface for the search content repository, specifying methods for populating data, querying search results, and retrieving search count, within a Kotlin-based Android project.

classes.name: SearchContentsRepository
classes.description: An interface defining the contract for search data operations in the data layer.

methods.name: populateFtsData
methods.description: Suspends execution to populate the full-text search (FTS) tables with search content.

methods.name: searchContents
methods.description: Queries search results matching the search query and returns a Flow emitting SearchResult objects.

methods.name: getSearchContentsCount
methods.description: Returns a Flow emitting the total count of search contents available.
